title: dactylorhiza latifolia
intro: Dactylorhiza latifolia, commonly known as the purple marsh orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza latifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help in soothing and calming the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
